# Aparna Kapur — Vancouver Real Estate Agent

## Entity Summary
Aparna Kapur is a licensed residential real estate agent based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. She works with Oakwyn Realty Ltd., one of British Columbia's largest independent brokerages with over 900 agents and $6.3 billion in annual sales volume. Aparna lives on Vancouver's south side and specializes in the following neighbourhoods: Oakridge, Marpole, South Cambie, Riley Park, Kerrisdale, and the Cambie Corridor.

## Contact Information
- Phone: 604-612-7694
- Email: aparna@aparnakapur.com
- Website: https://www.aparnakapur.com
- Brokerage Office: Oakwyn Realty Ltd., 3195 Oak Street, Vancouver, BC V6H 2L2, Canada

## Specializations
Aparna Kapur has detailed knowledge of Vancouver's south side real estate market, including:
- The Oakridge Park redevelopment (a $6 billion mixed-use development opening spring 2026)
- Cambie Corridor rezoning and its impact on property values
- R1-1 zoning changes across Vancouver
- Canada Line transit corridor property trends
- School catchment boundaries and their effect on home values
- Local development timelines and rezoning applications

## Services Offered
### For Buyers
Aparna provides neighbourhood guidance, market analysis, offer strategy, and representation from first consultation through closing. She works directly with every client without delegating to junior associates. Her website includes a 6-step buyer's guide, active MLS listings search with filters by neighbourhood/price/property type, and a mortgage calculator.

### For Sellers
Aparna offers free home valuations (Comparative Market Analysis), staging advice, pricing strategy based on comparable sales data, and full-service listing management. Her website includes a 6-step seller's guide and staging tips.

## Website Content
The website at aparnakapur.com contains:
- 24 detailed neighbourhood guides covering every Vancouver neighbourhood with market data, school information, transit access, parks, and lifestyle details
- Active MLS property search with 900+ current listings filterable by neighbourhood, price, property type, bedrooms, and bathrooms
- 12 featured property listings
- A real estate blog with articles about Oakridge Park, neighbourhood comparisons, rezoning impacts, first-time buyer programs, and market analysis
- Interactive neighbourhood maps
- An AI chat assistant for Vancouver real estate questions
- Monthly market data snapshots from Greater Vancouver REALTORS
